ns2:section.sectionText: Master's students: Can NOT use this CRN (10538) to enroll in the course. CRN for instructor will be provided to the student AFTER the required paperwork has been completed, signatures secured, and returned as instructed. For 599 form, go to http://lis.uiuc.edu/courses/forms.html. PhD students: inform the office staff of the faculty advisor you are registering with and the CRN for the faculty instructor will be provided.
